summary: Frontend-only verification of PaletteSwitcher React Portal refactor on MOOD for DESIGN. All 7 acceptance criteria PASS — popover now renders as a direct child of document.body, escapes all parent stacking contexts, and is fully visible (no clipping by dashboard cards). Position math (trigger.bottom + 8px) is exact (0.0px diff). Click-outside, Escape, scroll behavior, Brand Studio link, palette pick, and localStorage persistence all work correctly. No console / JS errors from the palette switcher.
critical_code_review_comments: PaletteSwitcher.jsx: coords are recomputed only on `open` change (useEffect dep). On window resize while popover is open, coords are NOT recomputed (the agent-to-agent note explicitly accepts this trade-off). If desired later, add a `resize` listener while open to keep alignment.

Unrelated: console shows background 401/503 errors during dashboard load — they are NOT from the palette switcher (likely a workspace data endpoint). Out of scope for this iteration but worth checking later.

PaletteSwitcher is not rendered on /admin (Control Center). Per the agent-to-agent context note, this is intentional (control-center surface overrides palette tokens), so the 'repeat on /admin' check is not applicable. Confirmed: no trigger DOM on /admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PaletteSwitcher portal refactor is fully verified on /dashboard. Verified facts: (1) popover.parentElement === document.body = true; (2) popTop = trigger.bottom + 8px exactly (0.0px diff at 1920x1080); (3) 15 light + 9 dark swatches all visible, 0 clipped/obscured; (4) click-outside on dashboard card closes, trigger re-opens, Escape closes; (5) position:fixed — scroll does not move popover (before=49.5, after=49.5 with scrollY=300); (6) rose palette applied → localStorage mfd_curated_palette='rose' persists after reload; (7) Brand Studio footer link navigates to /settings/brand-studio; (8) 0 ancestor elements with backdrop-filter/transform/filter/isolation/will-change in topbar chain — portal escapes them anyway. Palette switcher is intentionally NOT mounted on /admin.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous z-index:10010 fix did not work because some ancestor of .palsw-root in the topbar created a new stacking context. The React Portal approach (createPortal to document.body) is the definitive fix: by lifting the popover out of the DOM tree, it bypasses all parent stacking contexts entirely. The trigger remains in-flow inside .palsw-root, while the popover renders at body level with position:fixed and dynamic coords computed from triggerRef.getBoundingClientRect() on each open. Verified: no problematic ancestor styles found, popover.parentElement is BODY (not an inner topbar wrapper), and the popover is fully visible above all dashboard cards.
